project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo with educational content platform
build_system: pip with requirements.txt (no Makefile, no build step beyond install)
test_framework: bash fullstack-layer-test.sh (integration tests via curl against live API)
test_command: python -c "import app; print('imports ok')" from apps/backend/
verification_instructions: Run python -c to validate syntax, then check each modified file for correct logic
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No running MongoDB/Redis available in sandbox, so verification is limited to static analysis and import checks.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns in codebase.
key_patterns: Admin auth uses httponly cookie (syrabit_admin_session), not Bearer token. Circuit breaker pattern with OPEN/CLOSED/HALF_OPEN states. Beanie ODM for MongoDB. Razorpay SDK for payments. JWT with HS256 default, RS256 in production.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ contains: api/v1/ (route handlers), api/webhooks/ (webhook handlers), core/ (circuit breaker, security), services/ (search, chat, payment), models/ (Beanie documents), config.py (settings), main.py (FastAPI app)
